Interactive Voronoi maps

Source: vignettes/interactive.Rmd
interactive.Rmd
library(ggvmap)

Set interactive = TRUE on autoplot() or ggvmap() to turn any Voronoi map into an interactive graphic powered by ggiraph: cells highlight on hover and show a tooltip. Render the result with vm_girafe(). Everything works in R Markdown / Quarto, Shiny and the RStudio viewer.

A basic interactive map

Hover the cells — the tooltip shows the label and value.

vm <- voronoi_map(
  weights = c(30, 20, 50, 10, 40, 15, 25),
  labels  = c("Tech", "Health", "Energy", "Finance", "Retail", "Media", "Auto"),
  clip    = clip_circle(), seed = 42
)

autoplot(vm, interactive = TRUE) |>
  vm_girafe(width_svg = 6, height_svg = 6)

Custom tooltips

Pass tooltip = (length-n, named by label, or length 1) for your own hover text — HTML is supported.

tips <- paste0("<b>", vm$sites$label, "</b><br>", vm$sites$data_weight, "% share")

autoplot(vm, interactive = TRUE, tooltip = tips) |>
  vm_girafe(width_svg = 6, height_svg = 6)

Hierarchical map, interactive

Grouped layouts are interactive too; the default tooltip includes the group.

data(world_exports)

vmh <- voronoi_map(
  weights = world_exports$exports,
  labels  = world_exports$country,
  group   = as.character(world_exports$income_group),
  clip    = clip_circle(), seed = 1, max_iter = 80
)

autoplot(vmh, interactive = TRUE, label_size = 2) |>
  vm_girafe(width_svg = 6.5, height_svg = 6.5)

Notes

  • vm_girafe() accepts width_svg / height_svg (inches), a hover_css string, and extra ggiraph::opts_*() via opts =.
  • The static annotation layers (vm_add_ring(), vm_add_flags(), vm_add_labels()) render inside the interactive canvas as well — combine them before calling vm_girafe().
  • Saved with htmlwidgets::saveWidget(), an interactive map is a single self-contained .html file you can share.
g <- autoplot(vm, interactive = TRUE) |> vm_girafe()
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(g, "voronoi.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
